.gitlab-ci.yml:2: info artifacts-no-expiry
  The default artifacts have no expire_in; jobs "lint" and "audit" use them.
  why: Artifacts without expire_in are kept as long as the instance default
       allows: 30 days on GitLab.com, possibly forever on a self-managed
       instance. Most job artifacts are only needed by the next stages of the
       same pipeline.
  fix:
    default:
      artifacts:
        expire_in: 1 week

.gitlab-ci.yml:2: warning floating-image
  The default image "node:latest" uses the latest tag; jobs "lint" and "audit"
  use it.
  why: A floating image changes under the pipeline without any commit: the same
       commit can pass today and fail tomorrow, and nothing can be rebuilt as it
       was. `docker buildx imagetools inspect node:<version>` prints the digest.
  fix:
    default:
      image: node:<version>@sha256:<digest>

.gitlab-ci.yml:8: warning no-rules
  Job "lint" has no rules, only or except, so GitLab's defaults decide where it
  runs.
  why: By default a job runs on every branch and every tag. With workflow:
       rules, or with the project setting that skips branch pipelines for merge
       requests, it runs in every pipeline instead, merge requests included.
       Either way it rarely runs only where it is needed.
  fix:
    lint:
      rules:
        - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"

.gitlab-ci.yml:8: error redundant-job
  Job "lint" runs 2 times for the same commit: on the default branch and on the
  tag.
  why: With merged results pipelines and no direct pushes to the default branch,
       the merge request pipeline already tests the exact commit that lands on
       the default branch, and a tag only names that commit. Running the job
       again there cannot find anything new; it only costs runner time and
       delays the release.
  fix:
    lint:
      rules:
        - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH

.gitlab-ci.yml:12: info artifacts-no-expiry
  Job "unit" keeps its artifacts with no expire_in.
  why: Artifacts without expire_in are kept as long as the instance default
       allows: 30 days on GitLab.com, possibly forever on a self-managed
       instance. Most job artifacts are only needed by the next stages of the
       same pipeline.
  fix:
    unit:
      artifacts:
        expire_in: 1 week

.gitlab-ci.yml:12: info floating-image
  Job "unit" runs in image "golang:1.26", which is pinned by tag but not by
  digest.
  why: A tag can be pushed again with other content. A digest pins the exact
       image, so a rebuild uses the same bytes. `docker buildx imagetools
       inspect golang:1.26` prints the digest.
  fix:
    unit:
      image: golang:1.26@sha256:<digest>

.gitlab-ci.yml:12: info missing-interruptible
  Job "unit" runs on merge requests but does not set interruptible.
  why: When a new commit is pushed to a merge request, GitLab can cancel the
       pipeline of the previous commit, but a job that has started is cancelled
       only if it is interruptible. This one keeps running for a commit nobody
       will merge. Setting interruptible: true under default: covers every job
       at once.
  fix:
    unit:
      interruptible: true

.gitlab-ci.yml:23: warning unresolved-reference
  !reference [.missing] could not be found; what it stands for is treated as
  unknown.
  why: pipewise cannot tell what this part stands for, so the jobs that depend
       on it are reported as "maybe".

.gitlab-ci.yml: 8 findings: 1 error, 3 warnings, 4 info.
